description: This file defines the I18NLanguage entity class for the ORM, mapping to the ohrm_i18n_language table. It includes properties such as id, name, code, enabled, added, and modifiedAt, along with getter and setter methods for each. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and a trait for date/time helpers.

classes.name: I18NLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing a language for internationalization, mapping to the database table ohrm_i18n_language.
